assertionQuality.observes: Binary and text registrations preserve order, paths and zero/nonzero metadata handles. The actual furnsh effect is observed through loaded metadata/counts or all returned pool values. Missing/malformed loads require the specific CSPICE error name; partial effects/recovery are additionally compared live in kernel-boundaries.test.ts.

Repeated identical loads remain separate CSPICE database entries; one unload removes one reference. The actual furnsh effect is observed through loaded metadata/counts or all returned pool values. Missing/malformed loads require the specific CSPICE error name; partial effects/recovery are additionally compared live in kernel-boundaries.test.ts.

An authored empty meta-kernel is registered as TEXT, with its actual filtyp/handle. The actual furnsh effect is observed through loaded metadata/counts or all returned pool values. Missing/malformed loads require the specific CSPICE error name; partial effects/recovery are additionally compared live in kernel-boundaries.test.ts.

A malformed kernel reaches CSPICE after assigning an earlier variable; supplemental tests inspect retained partial pool state. The actual furnsh effect is observed through loaded metadata/counts or all returned pool values. Missing/malformed loads require the specific CSPICE error name; partial effects/recovery are additionally compared live in kernel-boundaries.test.ts.

Loading the corrected authored text fixture must populate actual numeric, integer and character pool values. The actual furnsh effect is observed through loaded metadata/counts or all returned pool values. Missing/malformed loads require the specific CSPICE error name; partial effects/recovery are additionally compared live in kernel-boundaries.test.ts.
